build_parallelize_module: build a function to apply tensor parallelism to a PyTorch module using a parallelize plan and device mesh
test_parallelize_module: test the parallelize_module function with a 1-D device mesh and ColwiseParallel style
refactor_parallelize_module: refactor the parallelize_module to support a 2-D device mesh by slicing to a 1-D sub mesh
review_parallelize_module: review the parallelize_module function that applies ParallelStyle to modules or sub-modules by fully qualified name
summarize_parallelize_module: summarize the parallelize_module function that sets up TP RNG state tracker and applies parallelization plans
